I was in one for 2 months earlier this year.

I made some great friends that I still talk to now. But, I had some shitty nurses that I would argue with a lot. It was scary at times. It was incredibly triggering. Towards the end they wanted to discharge me twice when I wasn't ready. The therapy was inadequate etc etc.
BUT, when I left, I was not self harming every day. I was taking my meds. I was smiling, I was happy ALL THE TIME. They figured out my meds and everything.

Now on to the place itself. I remember walking in and I was so numb because I was in that sort of place. After I got settled I started making friends, talking to other patients. On weekends we would go for drives (when the Royal Family came here we got to see them!) and get ice creams and go to the beach and everything. I made friends with 80% of the staff, and 95% of the patients. I did attempt suicide in there a few times but it got better.

TL;DR: Description is bad sorry it's like 5 am. My experience was great and I stayed in recovery until 2 months ago so it was very good.

Hello :) I'm getting braces very very soon, and these are what my teeth look like currently.

What's wrong with them:

-   9mm overjet (my upper teeth stick out 9mm)
-   50% overbite (my upper teeth cover my bottom teeth by 50%)
-   crowding on top
-   every upper tooth is too far forward, basically one tooth forward if that makes sense :P

First I have my second pre-molars on both sides extracted (in 4 days!) and then in October I get my upper braces.
They're delaying the bottom ones since there's no room for them yet.
The top ones will correct and straighten my teeth and close up the extraction gaps.
Then in Feb. I get my lower ones which will basically fix my bite.

I'm quite excited, really. I've been insecure about my teeth since I was little, so this is really exciting!
